Sex and ethnicity can narrow down a person's identity. Religion can also point to specific communities. Together, these details make it easier to connect the record to someone.

To improve privacy, the columns age, education, sex, ethnicity, and religion need better anonymization. For example, age could be grouped into ranges instead of exact numbers. Education could be simplified to broad categories. Sex and ethnicity could be generalized. Religion could be removed or anonymized. These changes would help protect individual identities better.

Risk scores represent ML model confidence under simulated attack conditions, not real-world re-identification probability.
